title: PHD2 Star-Lost Burst by Filter
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=phd2:guide
| search event="star_lost"
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as star_lost_events by _time filter_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks PHD2 star-loss events over time and breaks it out by filter.
value: Star-loss bursts often correlate with one filter, poor focus, or cloud bands that would otherwise be blamed on everything else.
implementation: Send PHD2 star-loss events events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of PHD2 star-loss events by filter.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how PHD2 star-loss events changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
